title: Wespa host fixture client: theme postMessage, sidebar drag + collapse/expand, same-origin message target
description: Classic (non-module) browser script served at /test-host.js when the test-host route is on. Three fixture behaviours: (a) the theme toggle posts `{ type: 'rcf-view-theme', theme }` to `iframe.contentWindow`, targeting `window.location.origin` so a cross-origin receiver would refuse the message (underwrites AC-206-4 together with the viewer's own origin check in page-init.js); (b) the sidebar drag handle sets `--wespa-sidebar-width` on the <main> grid, clamped to 64..400 px live; (c) collapse/expand snaps the sidebar between 64 px and 200 px. Reads the iframe's `data-theme` attribute as evidence of the postMessage round-trip (AC-206-2). After the iframe's hash-only navigation, `data-embed` and the search string carry embed=1 and the theme, which the live-proof script captures (AC-206-3). The host does not read event.origin (the viewer does) and does not persist theme to localStorage (ADR-4136 invariant).
